notes.title: Mining Update (0.11.1)
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings captains!


9 months in, the update is ready!
Try it in the playtest or demo!

Gameplay has been greatly changed putting more emphasys on mining, ship building and progression all togheter.[/h3]



	[b][h1]New asteroids[/h1][/b]

Each one holding hundreds of ore veins, enough to renovate your entire fleet.
Hide inside their craters but check for worms first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8d5cb4f2f57b00be445b0be2709e6f7854b83072.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New progression system[/h1][/b]

Getting drone cruisers and titanium in the starting sector but spending exactly 0 seconds in intermediary sectors until the center?
No more!, each sector has it's own ores and wave composition.
Now you will get to experience going through each upgrade tier rather than skipping half and never getting the last 2.
Other things like loot and player weapons have been chained for a progression oriented gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4e5a36fb9345e215d391c5a2a7d850f2c22f552d.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New cockpit[/h1][/b]

Annoyed to have to go to 4 consoles in the middle of combat? 
The new cockpit has all the controls available for your starship at your fingers.
300 buttons, countless texts and indicators comparable in complexity to real planes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ed46aea10439bc58d189bcbfd2eb8919de6edd27.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Breach based hull integrity[/h1][/b]

No more ship HP!, now damage consists of repairable breaches The Expanse style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/d5c8a7bbcf5b3d01c03fc6c3ee39d065b62b1537.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New battleship drone[/h1][/b]

If you though cruisers are hard then prepare for hell. 
Featuring colossal weapons and more loot than several planet bases combined they are the ultimate boss.	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f1533008db5a3dc2db82af66bef0ae134f9f33c6.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Improved docking[/h1][/b]

Steal ships by docking and boosting, brand new docking UI that's way easier to use and the ability to take docked ships to other sectors via mfm.
Catching up to a ship that's drifting at 10km/s, docking then bringing it to a station is a lot more fun that I expected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a95ea8a973032cc3e9a2f2620deed0fbe9b4eb14.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Boss waves[/h1][/b]

Normal waves to easy for you? Here's the +50% difficulty increase for last wave that nobody asked for and nobody wants.

	[b][h1]New space survival scenarios[/h1][/b]

Start with a wrecked ship and no stations around. A true space survival experience.
Say goodbye to the campaign since nobody knew(no even me) what it was supposed to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/d330a0511b3189a08fd2fec579ec944331574675.png[/img]

	[b][h1]PVP mode[/h1][/b]

You want it, I want it so let's get down to business and hunt each other down.
Still experimental, especially with Unity's limits on physics.

	[b][h1]Easier inter-deck building[/h1][/b]

Annoyed that you can repair or dismantle blocks only in the same deck? no more! 
You might need to place down flooring for decks for pre-existing ship designs.

	[b][h1]Improved automatons[/h1][/b]

2 new upgrade tiers for the old automaton with the ability to fix breaches and refill bottles on top of moving faster and having more hp.
They can coordinate to not take the same task and to go for the closest block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4cc823a03896f3b46648665988554f98ca323429.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Battle bridge[/h1][/b]

When the top saucer section bridge(I mean.... the navigation bridge) is too exposed for combat where do you go?
The new battle bridge offers 1m thick steel armor and is pressurized so you can breath fresh air when the ship hull is breached out of existence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/92235f81307eae34cbe630a8cd7225b3e2bf5de7.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New artifacts[/h1][/b]

Can't decide what do do with the 4 gargoholds of extra alien artifacts? No more!
Introducing 4 new relics that have specific uses and are needed to get end game gear including the top level automatons!
Spacial fold relic, Star cradle relic, Soul trap relic, Reverberating core relic, each representing destruction, heat, automation and ftl. You can even grow them out of each other!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/7bfd2837d56ce92ba9acb132c41189106148c8fd.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Teleporter mod[/h1][/b]

Beam me up Scoty!
Teleport at the door of the wreck directly!, no more jetpacking. One click to pay a visit to traders at the station.
To keep Adro realistic the teleporter is packaged as a mod.
It even comes with a beam-back remote!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2214e9aba8b7a4f45de214aeaa2734fca1ce2cc6.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]Vaulting[/h1][/b]

Who needs stairs anyway?

	[b][h1]Fly By Wire[/h1][/b]

How did Adro make it as a space sim for so many years without it?

	[b][h1]Pick up blocks[/h1][/b]

Tired of dismantling, recrafting and building again to redesign your ship? now just pickup and place with any tool.

	[b][h1]Weekly update notes panel[/h1][/b]

	Not a fan of discord but want to keep up with the development? Open the game from time to time and an in-game panel will appear with all the weekly development notes from my finger tips directly to your retina. Factorio friday facts Adrorium style. 

	[b][h1]Countless bugfixes & changes[/h1][/b]

I said countless? I mean I counted them, each one, 148 in total.

	[b][h1]Countless QoL features[/h1][/b]

These I really didn't count but there must be at least 30, including delta v calculations, more detailed ship ui indicators, faster start up time, sorted ship inventory, simplified recipes, +100% and +50% tool speed buffs on high morale, faster shields recharge time and many many more.

	[b][h1]Instructions block[/h1][/b]

With 15 visual guides on key aspects of Adro. Each ship comes equipped with one. No more 'Ma ship no workin, beholder, what do?'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ee938b61cfe2450b71e6cb3f42bbe2a6b90f26de.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Few more blocks[/h1][/b]

Like the fluid dispenser or text signs plus built in mods to get access to more previously uncraftable blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/6099005738e6806c022b882b59ec682ed47aef99.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Day 0 android port[/h1][/b]

So you can play right now with your weird cousin that somehow doesn't have a pc in 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/d62834cee2fdfa279dd3fa358e75a60e81877181.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Run by default[/h1][/b]

Pinky finger hurts from holding shift non stop? Now you will never have to touch it again(shift, not the finger) and once you get used to it, you will never walk again #alwaysrunning. Running in Adro is not a viable substitute for running in real life.

	[b][h1]Bloom & Ambient occlusion[/h1][/b]

I don't care about graphics. 'Messes with bloom.' I didn't care about graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/fc19200a63a942b59dcbe5e488eba757cd06b258.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/924ba29d69eda70e85c7b8ec0608a358e88bcf17.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Updated tutorial[/h1][/b]

With indicators for buttons, simpler steps and no more softlocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f535d301ea8b06100da956e5671689e64f4d1d0f.png[/img]


[url=https://pastebin.com/raw/Y5s20mYu]Full changelog[/url]

	
Did you catch all the references?




Signing out,
Beholder

notes.title: Colossal Update (0.11.0)
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings captains!


This update is ready, now!
You can play it through the demo or beta playtest.

One of the largest updates so far that completely changes progression and the way you build your ship.[/h3]


	[b][h1]Automaton[/h1][/b]

Your own personal handyman capable of repairing, rebuilding and farming. It is yet unknown what powers its internal systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/266cd4e21cbab69a5e53383a44deea98cddfd9b1.png[/img]

	[b][h1]PDA designer[/h1][/b]

Tired of blindly building your ship? now you can see and plan out the design directly from the pda.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/bbe0eba0aff826b692e730083923a41abdf41237.png[/img]


	[b][h1]New progression system & 5 new metals[/h1][/b]

With the new tiered blocks you have to make several stops along the way to pick up increasingly more valuable resources to build those new colossal hardware. Progression is locked behind 5 new materials that are found the deeper you go into the galaxy: 
[b]
[list]
[*] Steel
[*] Duralumin
[*] Cobinel
[*] Bio-Molecular Iron
[*] Bio-Molecular titanium
[/list]
[/b]

	[b][h1]Asteroids everywhere[/h1][/b]

Do you even need an explanation for this? Mining has finally became a profitable time investment, especially with asteroids made out of gold that fill the central sectors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2d990399981cb9e4f80949ecbd16d41bc54f9d15.png[/img]


	[b][h1]9 new gatlings[/h1][/b]

With 400x more power than the tier 1, the new colossal variants will shred any drone in seconds. Finally a good alternative to railguns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/78960c6175fbf7250ef70b01a35ba4dfe7cd3162.png[/img]

	[b][h1]9 new rocket launchers[/h1][/b]

Annoyed by the barrage of missiles drones throw at you? Now you can annoy them as well, without the worry that the launchers will get destroyed. Not sure why they still attack when they see a rocket launcher that is bigger than your ship....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/3774092960558de280d08094333cc7d6bbe1ba37.png[/img]

	[b][h1]9 new boosters[/h1][/b]

Annoyed by the bed of boosters you had to build/repair on your ship? One Colossal booster is more than enough to propel you to the other side of the universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/270a87ae029e77a845fd4308c2bcf26bfb19e3c9.png[/img]

	[b][h1]9 new rcs blocks[/h1][/b]

Disappointed you can't get the ship to spin at 120 rpm fast enough to annoy your crewmates? Now you can. Please don't.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/1dbb94510c32bca272460b8c80d28b864d908461.png[/img]

	[b][h1]45 new tank blocks[/h1][/b]

To fuel your new colossal boosters and rcs. New fluid: Xenon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4a084a90a245f3bc42fbb1d1caba6bab641df3b2.png[/img]



	[b][h1]Inventory fetching V2 (MP)[/h1][/b]

Annoyed your crew keeps that cargobox locked all the time? Now you have access to the contents of the box for crafting, fetching, upgrading and farming in multiplayer without having to interact with it.


	[b][h1]New main ship: Canigva[/h1][/b]

Major version comes with a major redesign. Now with scalable tank positions, nicer room layout and a single airlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/6e367a90adb6cd5d0e0b15f7a1ce6392e24da081.png[/img]


	[b][h1]More modding options[/h1][/b]

Add your own turrets, boosters, npcs and basically any already defined block, no restrictions. Turrets can consume from a secondary grid and several new options.


	[b][h1]Rewrite for most of the code[/h1][/b]

As with any 0.x version, a lot of the code was rewritten, especially the pda, asset managing, ship firing and input.


	[b][h1]Crafting areas[/h1][/b]

Access all crafters directly from your own inventory. No more back and forth to each one for intermediate ingredients. *Convenience*

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/28d42400214ba91eeb542dad65599a8f2064a18e.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Orbit mechanics[/h1][/b]

Always wanted your ship to freefal into the planet without worrying that it will crash? now you get the ui to help you do that. Gotta rush celestial navigation now that ksp2 is dead.


	[b][h1]Automated ship firing[/h1][/b]

For truly afk space battles.


	[b][h1]Simplified many recipes[/h1][/b]

Because I know how much you hate spending time figuring out intermediate ingredients.


	[b][h1]4 times bigger planets[/h1][/b]

Now that you have overpowered colossal boosters you need a new challenge to compensate: escape the colossal planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/aad16c678d0945e1ff02efd61991d5ceddeb852d.png[/img]

notes.title: Convenience Update (0.10.5)
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi captains!


This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the playtest option or through the demo. 

The update consists of a multitude of features designed to improve the quality of the game:[/h3]


	[b][h1]Planet survival scenarios[/h1][/b]

Sick of always starting in space with a fully functional ship? Survive and eventually repair a wrecked ship to escape the harsh environment in the new planet survival scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5ff1c662853a9704458f166fd59c7b0dbf523be3.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Inventory fetching[/h1][/b]

Inventory management is the final boss in most games and it's not fun. I know. Now you can fetch/pull inventory directly from the ship for crafting, planting and repairing. Quick send to ship also included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/137784a47633c27ceebb1ae7cd7a3d26c488169f.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Reliable multiplayer connection[/h1][/b]

Developed a brand new reliable network module for multiplayer to ensure packets are going to reliably arrive to your peers. Say goodbye to de-syncs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/28ecff221cd2e0ec7c9f2127349c7b8cead20f14.png[/img]


	[b][h1]4 new pois and drones[/h1][/b]

With 2 more drone variants and 2 more planet base designs the game will no longer feel so similar in your away missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8d5a5568319a2ae04f9f09b7394493f8547b6bb3.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Adjacent upgrade[/h1][/b]

Who has time to dismantle the smaller blocks in order to build a larger one? Not me, just place 4 tanks of same type together and a new mega tank will take their place. 2 mega tanks make a colossal one, more than enough to fuel your booster bed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/dc97d4ab479508cacf7f25a296817a34ac3018f6.gif[/img]


	[b][h1]New blocks and new items[/h1][/b]


[b][h2]Beacon[/h2][/b]
Want to score a new record but don't have time to wait for the waves to come? The beacon will broadcast your location making them come 4 times faster.
[b][h2]Semiconductor Fabricator[/h2][/b]
Running low on CPUs and ICs, craft them yourself, no engineering knowledge required. Be careful!, this block is very expensive to build.
[b][h2]New tanks and battery variants[/h2][/b]
Introducing the new Colossal and Mega variants for the Tanks and for the Batteries. 600% the capacity for 400% the size and it stacks exponentially(32x capacity for 16x size).
[b][h2]Blast Door[/h2][/b]
Who likes breaches? Doors make more sense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f16ccd75b4765fcbd17782d2411080320a8107cc.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Finish game event[/h1][/b]

Move aimlessly across the galaxy and eventually quit without any catharsis? Clear the central sector to mark your achievement into the game and into the leaderboard. Big notifications and a reward included.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e543fe0e370bb71491bc1b563b7ed33a966fa032.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Atmosphere navigation[/h1][/b]

Get the necessary info to keep your ship on the correct trajectory with the new horizon and altitude indicators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5172105dd4d644165c5f5ab64a6ecf6546aaf648.gif[/img]


	[b][h1]New crafting & trading panel design[/h1][/b]

Because both needed an overhaul. New keybinds for stack crafting included.
With the new trading panel you can sell anything as long as it is an item and has some value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ffc1eb1fb3f7187f4c665445c0cb13306c0a97b6.png[/img]


	[b][h1]New 3d models & images for items[/h1][/b]

As with any update, I strive to bring a sense of consistent design across the entire game, thus adding 30 new models for items. And who doesn't like to both see the crensel cake and also eat it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4050b72209c29f95346ca62fb04c11bd6f62d148.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Deck editing with tools[/h1][/b]

I can't believe I didn't have this before, just right click and left click to edit the floor/roof of any adjacent deck. Perfect for making space for colossal tanks and panoramic views.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f66e1b36f8d1ede4b63cbf97c85b771f98d66e7c.gif[/img]


	[b][h1]Popup crafting panel[/h1][/b]

Searching recursively for recipes is not fun. That's why now you can simply click on the missing ingredient and a popup with the available recipes for it will appear to quickly craft your pistol without having to switch crafting tabs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/9e72133bb838f1dbc36c051d2ad660801b8278ff.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Remote mission taking[/h1][/b]

Dock -> get mission -> undock takes to long. Just hail the station and the mission list will be downloaded on the electronics console for you to take. Convenient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/55354599bf9ac1e7c0ca69fac7e287b4d16c1d11.png[/img]


	[b][h1]New Autopilot/ Nav. Assist options[/h1][/b]

Another QoL feature is the improved nav assist. With the new options to 
- automatically revert mid-way, 
- prevent overshooting,
- stop on proximity and 
- stop on collision 
you won't have to worry about the journey while you enjoy you crensel smoothie on the observation deck. What self driving level is that? 3?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a368fd42342c4bf8e1280965464b24127c87bbe9.png[/img]


	[b][h1]New player & suit model for mp[/h1][/b]

Our avatar got a face lift!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/68336ed22c641d77fcfa79adcf13e88973b3effd.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Over 390 fixes/small qol features[/h1][/b]

Many smaller convenience features were added like:
- Suits drop when suitdocks are dismantled, same with hydroponics and seeds.
- More info on item description panel.
- Ammo is returned when weapon is sold/dismantled.
- Kick/ban/unban from pda.
- Detailed damage report directly on the driving hud.
- Start weapons and engines with one button each.
- Wave warning notifications.
- Detailed crew stats on the player list ui.
- Removing windows/cargo doors/airlocks no longer depressurizes the ship.
- Upgrading tanks/batteries doesn't lose their stored content.
And many more.


[img][/img]


	[b][h1]Fire through shields[/h1][/b]

Finally you won't have to worry about getting hit because shields flicker to allow your projectiles. The new algorithms for shield emitters allows firing without having to turn the shields temporarily off. 

[img][/img]


	[b][h1]Passive healing[/h1][/b]

Not having access to medical pods dooms you into a death loop. Just give it few minutes and your health will improve up to a point ... or more exactly, up to 50 points.

[img][/img]


	[b][h1]Turret ammo unloading[/h1][/b]

Since you never use the gatling rounds because you can't land any hit why not sell them? 20K free at the start of the game? Sign me up!

[img][/img]


	[b][h1]Hover mode for ships[/h1][/b]

Now this is a very convenient feature, gone are the days of throttling and having to manually remove the boosters to reduce as much as possible the vertical acceleration in atmosphere. Now you can even leave the ship inclined and it will eventually get to it's destination without crashing and without anyone driving (if you know how).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/77a0b4ac6dcc6a0a69b61254de669cee4a5f9ae8.gif[/img]


	[b][h1]Lots of balancing[/h1][/b]

A lot of recipes were changed, intermediate items removed and values tweaked in order to make the experience of playing as convenient as possible. New game loops were introduced like semiconductor crafting or turret recycling.

[img][/img]


	[b][h1]Auto item equip[/h1][/b]

Look at a tank, hold F and automatically you will get the filled pouches from ship inventory and start pouring them one after another. Same for tools, heals, seeds, battery and reactor rods. One held key(F) to rule them all.

[img][/img]


	[b][h1]2 times larger planets[/h1][/b]

Planet survival on a 32km planet? Nope, double it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/fac03c25abc38cddedb475ac2a4e02615e50381f.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Clientside projectiles[/h1][/b]

No longer get hit by invisible projectile because you live 500 milliseconds away. If you don't get hit from the projectiles that you can see, YOU DON'T GET HIT.

[img][/img]

If you are interested in the full changelog, access it here: [url=https://beholdernx.itch.io/adrorium/devlog/627246/v0105-changelog-convenience-update]Full Changelog 0.10.5[/url]

Signing out,
Beholder

notes.title: Energy Update (v0.10.4)
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi captains!


This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the playtest option or through the demo. 

Those are the highlights:[/h3]


	[b][h1]Electrolyzer, fuel cells, transformer[/h1][/b]

Ever run out of o2 and h2 but had mountains of unused water? Or are the turbines not providing enough power for you? I got you covered, convert liquids with each other and with both electricity grids like joggling balls. 
[b]Electrolyzer[/b]: 2*h2o + electricity => h2 + 2*o2
[b]Fuel cells[/b]: h2 + 2*o2 => 2*h2o + electricity
[b]Transformer[/b]:  (Boost mode) Aux grid => Main grid, (Buck mode) Main grid => Aux grid

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/fd6dc78af2849066fd623e0bf3caebaf32d9e1a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/cc74f6e1b78545fc310fbe31c003567a3d58ec38.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/0537b122952b2e3ab4910eeae296bbcc7d5b1fe2.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Fusion & singularity reactors[/h1][/b]

Do you have nothing to sink your resources into in the end-game? Well, those 2 overpowered reactors will give you enough plasma to power a entire planet... sustainably.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e27e427585e42e1970f6204fcc2f16d45cb0da70.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8ce5b35edfda47ede00a7d567d905e677c5965a2.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New precise building system[/h1][/b]

No more overlaps and nice building animation. Did I mention you can place multiple blocks in the same voxel (1x1x1m) if they don't physically overlap? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/904ccfe653808956dc270c068f9a48949cd8ed52.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ab5c6a4b32c58715e059fbfe05d45db7915cb1f7.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]RCS nozzle effects[/h1][/b]

No space sim is complete without RCS nozzle particles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/018043fa266c754814a6e2d060c93d06cd81a7ea.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]New suitdock, lift, deck elevator and cargodoor[/h1][/b]

You will learn to love the deck elevator, up and down, get to other decks in no time, gone are the days of stairs or ladders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f1d162aeb98213b747d8f98fbd73ee376b54af8e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5c672f240ec6bfe4f501e5b0ee9e85cdc214a47f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a3c03bdd56b41ed1d9724cdf417d598e9e49740c.png[/img]


	[b][h1]Updated energy console[/h1][/b]

Well... we can't have all those new energy blocks without a 80 button startup procedure, now can we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/172a79ca12ab3871868c27a8c873a7a565602aad.png[/img]

	[b][h1]All blocks on inside[/h1][/b]

Tired of running around the ship to find the damaged blocks? Say no more. Ship maintenance is gonna be way easier when you can see which blocks were damaged with the new damage indicators, just hold a tool in your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2de816b36e8cfa00bea3cd84d108cdb2cfb87fe1.png[/img]

Removed lots of unneeded or abundant items, added few more intermediary recipe ingredients and removed all weapons from loot since you can craft them now. Added recipes for some blocks and simplified others.

	[b][h1]New item icons[/h1][/b]

Did I mention this is a overhaul update? where I mostly improve a preexisting part of the game, well lots of items got new 3d renders as icons of AAA quality. Would you believe me if I told you some of them were 5 years old?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/05b5bc4e3c8fd3a1e6611c8ca4b9b3439a10f2b4.png[/img]

Reloading, firing, boosters and airlock sounds got a level up and it's not in volume.

I even wonder how could some bugs make it so far into development without getting caught...

	[b][h1]Performance improvements[/h1][/b]

Drastically reduced draw calls by batching meshes of the same type into a single call. Made planet bases spawn around the player instead of having precalculated spawn positions to reduce save file size. Less triangles and draw calls from the new blocks. Also recycled materials for multiple blocks to prevent expensive gpu context changes.

	[b][h1]Other changes[/h1][/b]

New material for fps hands, instant crafting and speed info on driving ui are some of the new additions as well as improved item and mission modding. Steam integration is in prototype phase so next update expect full support. Vehicles and current time are shown on UI. Tools have further reach and undocking can be done from cockpit.




Signing out,

Namium, nurins, olis, crensel, artein and tiuras. You will learn to rely on them for subsistence since the traders won't sell you anything edible anymore, jerks. Did you know you can plant things other than seeds and crops? Find out what :).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a314619ff2c836100bd7186ca252c45a93f96fc9.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New shield system and blocks[/h1][/b]

Remember when you used to press one button to completely recharge the shields? Now they recharge very slowly and only when deactivated but can be stacked to increase the shield capacity.
Because one is too few and 3 are to many.... for a normal ship, 9 tiers should be enough to make your ship a moving bullet black hole. They also look nice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/385f1b7ec2b6a24cb4b33e559f7b9095c4d82428.png[/img]

	[b][h1]17 new food items[/h1][/b]

Each with it's own reference, can you name them all? You thought I would make a farming update without adding a use for the plants? Guess again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/aab0cc3df42ea12907764e6be0271987e64f7bc0.png[/img]

	[b][h1]New models for 32 current blocks[/h1][/b]

In line with the aesthetics of Adro.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a9be77d16d016bdfe43c4f5c5ed5d270b29ffba0.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Target tracking[/h1][/b]

For those that can't git gud. If you think the new shields are op wait until you see this. Need the mainframe to access this overpowered ship ability. All projectiles are way faster now so at close range all hits are guaranteed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ecb70ee830552deab8724b91ca4f910bdb7a8d24.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]Feedback & news panels[/h1][/b]

For when you can't be bothered to join Discord, share with me your precious feedback and receive them precious news, directly from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/55e74fc31e29392bc1ed5c6b26fb4061f3ad13c6.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Configurable brightness & light quality[/h1][/b]

All about supporting computers with lower specs, hey, not all simulated realities can afford to have more than one quality light source. 
For when your audience only sees black in your twitch streams, pump the brightness up to blinding to silence them.

	[b][h1]Hull breach fixing[/h1][/b]

No longer have to scrap that nanoscopic collider in the frame block, the new hull breaches require patch plates to fix and have a proper full area collider.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e38a4cb053fce103886e9627a58b3cf6f5f7cd3a.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]Lots of fixes and tweaks[/h1][/b]

Removing unneeded steps/items/recipes, you know... making the gameplay less grindy. Made missions actually worth doing, added more navigation info, more recycling to prevent excess items and many other QoL modifications.

	[b][h1]Proper audio modding[/h1][/b]

Thanks to naudio (library) you can bring your own melodic creations into Adro. Variable bit rate, multi/single channel, yes we support them all.

	[b][h1]Auto port forwarding[/h1][/b]

Can't be bothered to connect to your router to do a port forward?, do these words sound like Chinese? I got you covered. By default Adro will let others connect to you over internet even if your network does not allow it, as long as your router knows the UPNP protocol.

	[b][h1]Dedicated server mode[/h1][/b]

Automation at its finest, script a server to start/stop from a shell/command prompt on a remote machine without human intervention. There are also special commands like ban, unban, kick, restart and all the usual management set.

	[b][h1]Lots of new modding options[/h1][/b]

Block light modding, farming modding, liquids/grids fill level modding and blocks particle effects modding, let your creative aberrations become alive in Adrorium.






Signing out,
Beholder

notes.title: LookShift Update (v0.10.1)
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi captains!


This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the playtest option or through the demo. 

Those are the highlights:[/h3]


	[b][h1]New models for most blocks & new blocks[/h1][/b]

The main scope of this update was to improve the visuals of the game (let's face it, they were horrible before), so I remodeled almost all blocks and now Adro looks completely different, some might even call it a look shift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/0bc2a064b7255e58b9aa1ad8a841c718d804036c.png[/img]



	[b][h1]New energy console[/h1][/b]

Power up the reactors, enable the dockports, see the block energy consumption and many more options from the same console.
With the new modern and compact look it is designed to replace all the other energy related consoles. Did I mention it is fully modable?
Unique to this console is that it lists the energy consumption and generation for each grid for each block. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2a249c800af6b18dcc4ad9fa791e327646208ff4.gif[/img]



	[b][h1]New multiplayer framework[/h1][/b]

Goodbye Photon. The new framework based on UNET is way more stable, has less desyncs and it is faster since it involves a direct connection. It comes with a default server listing option. However you will need to portforward/use Hamachi if you want to play over internet.



	[b][h1]New items and recipes[/h1][/b]

Build the reactor after the first loot run? don't think so, the new resources will scale the progression fairly.



	[b][h1]Implemented voice commands[/h1][/b]

When you just can't be bothered to use your hands. Raise shields, fire weapons, debug teleport, fire boosters and many more available commands under your very finger tips, I mean vocal cords.



	[b][h1]New block upgrade chain[/h1][/b]

But I already upgraded this block 6 times, how much more powerful can it get? On the other hand what else can I do with these end game resources...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8a2ef397ec27a14b8e0957233587803099794e42.png[/img]



	[b][h1]Reworked loot/scrap progression[/h1][/b]

Did all these cargo containers from wreckages feel unrealistic? I mean who leaves perfectly fine loot just hanging around? Nobody. But who uses loot to build blocks instead of putting it in cargo? Everyone, yes, everyone. Except you, probably, good thing you don't have to loot your own ship, hopefully.....hopefully. Scrap the wreckages if you want the goodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/c5466257fcf521f0ffba64e228a4dc1cc83a26d2.png[/img]



	[b][h1]Ship speed is now saved[/h1][/b]

Oh my, am I going at 14Km/s towards that planet? let me just quick save 'n load to avoid flattening my ship... oh wait... well it was a nice run.



	[b][h1]New button layout for consoles[/h1][/b]

Removed some buttons here, added more buttons there, you know.... Just ensuring each button is not just a means of unlocking the... next button.



	[b][h1]Updated ship designs[/h1][/b]

Can't add all these new blocks and leave the ships hangin'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/1164471bddd011fc2e42f343e554d73ef4dbbfa9.png[/img]



	[b][h1]Nicer planet material[/h1][/b]

That Voronoi pattern surely looks better than the simple gradient. You will definitely notice it when you land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/6ceeb3fdd4a33ede160e1035275931b6cef88f76.png[/img]



	[b][h1]Overhauled rover driving[/h1][/b]

Sick of the rover flipping inside the ship? The new driving system is simulating the physics at the wheel level instead of the rover level.



	[b][h1]Multi screen ratio support[/h1][/b]

It's 'multi ratio', not 'multi screen', but it's just as useful, now you can have any ratio you want as long as it's greater than a square (1:1), lets see that 5760x1080 go go go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/961006018617bbec0df8c32f315a94e3c6d72cb5.png[/img]



	[b][h1]Image modding[/h1][/b]

For when you need to replace the ugly vanilla screwdriver item icon with your ugly screwdriver item icon.



	[b][h1]Updated manual[/h1][/b]

For all of those who keep looking for answers inside the game instead of Discord.





Signing out,
Beholder

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/09ce5ec01bc13cf9e66f7e42d5448f8d3ec2a49c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/b7f05402072f50695b8c768fdf9dd394a5451ef0.png[/img]
	[b][h1] New ui chat, popup and title[/h1][/b]

		No longer will you have to endure the old static 'notification' text,  the new version brings a brand new chat panel, title popup for mission completion or other important events and small popups for less important events like crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/733e39386208dbc8f781aaa43479efb9e70cecdd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/dbd5ba2f86f200db7a1627a7a0cac997a88cd934.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2a227e3b1b9b84d31c2d91d177145767a9109a7a.png[/img]
	[b][h1] New diplomacy system[/h1][/b]

		Used to scrapping the station blocks for a quick resource grab? No longer will the inhabitants permit that. Break few blocks and the wrath of the station will be unleashed on you and your ship with a barrage of railguns and multiple interior turrets shredding your ship in mere moments. Damaging ships will reduce your reputation with that faction. The new diplomacy system allows you to see the reputation and declare war to other factions directly from your pda.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/14df0f2e8d8fecd4f66bc8b113157c897944eaa6.png[/img]

	[b][h1] Projectiles inherit ship velocity[/h1][/b]

		No longer will you have to worry about bullets hitting your own ship, now projectiles inherit the ship's speed so you can have dogfights at 10s of 1000 of meters per second. Turrets are also prevented from firing at their own ship. 

	[b][h1] Aiming assist[/h1][/b]

		Since projectiles don't go forward but inherit ship's speed, the new aiming assist tells you exactly in which direction to fire in order to land a successful hit, taking into consideration your velocity, the target velocity, the distance and projectile speed, all for each individual weapon type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/1d9c619afa4967279a624824b8453cac88f80f5a.png[/img]
	[b][h1] Updated crafting tree and loot tables[/h1][/b]

		Since you used to be left with boxes of useless components, the new recipes will help you in converting all the unusable loot into useful components. 

	[b][h1] New enemy AI[/h1][/b]

		With the new turrets no longer requiring forward alignment the enemy factions have become way more dangerous. The new AI for drones will track you from many kilometers away and the turrets will make avoiding enemy fire way more difficult.

	[b][h1] Automated and multifunctional tools[/h1][/b]

		Annoyed by having to click a billion times to do a simple tool action? With the new automated tools you just have to hold click. Also tools now are able to do everything, no more specialized tools, the only difference is that some tools are way faster than others. 

	[b][h1] Markers[/h1][/b]

		A extremely useful feature that allows for a lot of optimizations by replacing entire ships or spawn positions with markers. In future versions it will get even more functionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4974cb25b33824f44a422300e227bc27213688f9.png[/img]
	[b][h1] Dynamic lights[/h1][/b]

		With this feature lights from far away no longer consume performance. Only the close enough light sources are activated based on distance.

	[b][h1] New inventory and log panel design[/h1][/b]

		To finally get read of that ugly 3 year old design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4055ff661e334b11afa178e99cee60d4217142f9.png[/img]
	[b][h1] 2 times larger sectors[/h1][/b]

		To account for the larger planets and for the abundance of resources from wreckages.

	[b][h1] Massive performance optimizations[/h1][/b]

		Stations and planet bases no longer spawn unless you get closer to them. Simplified the hierarchy and colliders for most blocks. Savefiles cache the ship designs to drastically reduce size.
	[b][h1] New framework for missions[/h1][/b]

		With new additional objectives, easier to use format and configurable start and end actions.

	[b][h1] New ui animations[/h1][/b]

		Yes, the ui is now animated!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/860791be8b74c56412aca8758d9e7a6535d7e083.gif[/img]
	[b][h1] Extended modding support[/h1][/b]

		Block modding supports hierarchical structure and configurable behavior, planet types are completely configurable, gametypes have lots of new options and many more configuration options for mods.
	[b][h1] Updated creative panel[/h1][/b]

		Items from creative panel have been organized into groups.

	[b][h1] 14 new blocks and few new items[/h1][/b]

	[b][h1] New settings[/h1][/b]

		Mostly for planet quality and size and for some of the sector properties like sector size.

	[b][h1] Explored status for wreckages[/h1][/b]

		No longer will you be wondering if you explored a wreckage or station. The targeting ui will indicate if there still is something left to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/3f8adab8ce19dd5536b7c34008acc2683be0c711.png[/img]
	[b][h1] New shield material and sunflare[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/1c101bd4db2be52df48862de306c5113fbe482af.png[/img]
	[b][h1] Lots of new chat commands[/h1][/b]

		To see all of them press /help or /helpdetailed in chat. Some of the new commands are related to diplomacy, ship grids and locked for interaction blocks.

	[b][h1] Rewrite for the majority of the code[/h1][/b]

		This is the largest Update so far and most of the frameworks have been rewritten from scratch including missions, saving& loading, savefile format, planets, block modding and so on.

	[b][h1] Ship model exporter[/h1][/b]

		Ever wanted to make a nice scene in blender with ships from Adro? Just press the export ship model button from creative menu and you'll get the .obj ship model file ready to import into blender.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8b21e7d41e3e9d6f8d8eade41e80fb00792b16bb.png[/img]
	[b][h1] Projectile shield bounce chance[/h1][/b]

		Shield deflection will require you to pay attention for the angle of attack.

	[b][h1] Fixed pda to belt[/h1][/b]

		Your pda (including the map) is locked to the first slot of the belt. Now you can't lose the pda, get locked of your own ship or not have access to the map. It is also way easier to use with the new M and ~  key bindings.

	[b][h1] Lots of bugfixes and tweaks[/h1][/b]




If you want to support the game try the demo and wishlist!

Full changelog here: https://pastebin.com/raw/Rn7uG00N


For feedback, discussions and question
https://discord.gg/Wsqnqh1


Have fun driving,
Beholder

notes.title: Lander Update (v0.9.1)
notes.notes:
[h3]Hy captains!

This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the demo so what are you waiting for?

Those are the highlights:[/h3]


	[b][h1]Planet Landing[/h1][/b]

		Yes, your dreams of crashing your weird ship on the surface of a planet are possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a891cafafc8b0490f8d75c3e94fed17cc3648005.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]New Rover[/h1][/b]

	You gotta love the new design, but wait... 
		- 3 seats? checked. 
		- 2 suit racks? checked. 
		- 2 cargoholds? checked. 
		- Suspensions? checked. 
		- Waist disposal? checked. 
		- Bed? checked. 
		- Fits neatly inside the ship? checked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/27e2d9af2dfc32518eb12a84bb3d53c937fc70d4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/94c078196ca891ad4a1405f8383a6565a4fefaeb.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Collision damage[/h1][/b]
	
		All hands, brace for impact!! Your ship is the larges projectile that you can fire after all.

	[b][h1]New Booster[/h1][/b]
	
		With a way nicer model and proper visual effects, the new booster comes with a additional vertical mode that is perfect for landing on planets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5e3fec8d71f145452bbb7aac09ced452fb1a6af6.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Simplified crafting tree[/h1][/b]
	
		Say goodbye to most intermediate ingredients, Adro is a spaceship/survival game, not a factory line.

	[b][h1]Sniper[/h1][/b]
	
		When anything except headshots is not acceptable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f4b64ba1baa1f2e591e3302f00974cb6cc1051bf.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Crouching[/h1][/b]
	
		Stuck on ships often or want to go through small corridors? Crouching will allow you to go through a 1x1 meter opening. Remember that turrets can't fire at you if you are under them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/b8bc033471c7a8f3a16e96d6e8ec11f742efa633.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]New ships[/h1][/b]
	
		First vanilla multi deckers are here. They feature 4 boosters, a rover hold and a lot of extra space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/184b029b73b173236b6737f18b6d0c7536445ee8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/b2bb2a09266d5d02edd0b70ba975c5a54d5117c9.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Deck floors and hatch[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ddb27ab84b2f9e53ac2a519939f6d5a5a9ac1344.png[/img]

	[b][h1]Hull depressurization[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/b422f5eeafd87c9ba70790d6c940e1b6ab36ea71.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]Discord integration[/h1][/b]
	
		So the entire world can see what ship are you driving directly from your discord profile.

	[b][h1]New dying mechanics[/h1][/b]
	
		No longer will you be spawned kilometers away from your ship as a penalty, dead is dead now and you are a descendant, just don't be disappointed when you realize the ship you inherited has been looted.

	[b][h1]Ship oxygen consumption[/h1][/b]
	
		Doesn't it feel nice to know that when a dial indicates 0 you will die? Might need to draw straws when you won't have enough 02 for everyone until you arrive at the station.

	[b][h1]Aiming zoom[/h1][/b]
	
		All weapons now have a zooming effect when aiming. A sniper is not a sniper without a scope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a3947899c2bafa6166371a19765bdccb641384fa.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]Vehicle crafting[/h1][/b]
	
		Now that rovers are no longer found near planets or in any other spot for that matter you will need to be able to build one yourself.

	[b][h1]Docking camera[/h1][/b]
	
		Beep beep beep, docking will be more immersive now.

	[b][h1]Masterserver[/h1][/b]
	
		Servers from other continents will show up on the list.


	[b][h1]Updated audio system for all blocks[/h1][/b]
	
		Crisp audio effects for all blocks even at light speed.

	[b][h1]New cargodoor[/h1][/b]
	
		Specially designed for the rover, just don't forget to power them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/c3a68cc50d4c754fe0200bcb720dd339f1d9ad97.png[/img]

		Even ingredient ratios, lees boxes of useless items and no more abundance of food and weapons in loot.

		How else would you know you are crashing into a planet?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e633080dea07a0c36bc385dbfef971e21a67cb20.gif[/img]

	[b][h1]Screenshots with F10[/h1][/b]

	[b][h1]Target trail indicator[/h1][/b]
	
		Keep the ship aligned now even in reverse boost mode.

notes.title: 0.9.0 Major update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi captains,

The 0.9.0 update (largest to date) is out!
You can play it yourself through the demo so what are you waiting for?

Here are the highlights:[/h3]

	
	[b][h1]NEW CAMPAIGN[/h1][/b]
	
		First chapter is ready and it involves the steps leading to the first hostile encounter.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ac810247931300eb309ba102efd479dcd07e0983.png[/img]
		
	[b][h1]NEW HULL EDITING FRAMEWORK[/h1][/b]
	
		This is a major feature, now you can use hull pieces, walls and drill to modify the hull of the ship.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/0fae4a1810e805b1c9926d5a5905b49fd32514c6.gif[/img]
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/571d6013f8550cac0a96368433be3f93107d7782.gif[/img]
		
	[b][h1]NEW COCKPIT[/h1][/b]
	
		Complete redesign of the cockpit, more information presented in a better screen based interface.
		Each of the 5 cockpit screens has a specific purpose: system stats, combat, targeting, navigation and sensors.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a77e1837eea61965aba86e2741c2ef7955ce6742.gif[/img]
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/08becdcc1ef56b623a0083d2216ffc90bb3af273.png[/img]
		
	[b][h1]PLAYER WEAPON RELOADING[/h1][/b]
	
		Self explanatory. 
		This feature also allows storing more information per item so spoil time, quality or level can be added in future versions very easily.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/069dd5e7785f75cccca786f690e9055a8ed15858.gif[/img]
		
	[b][h1]MULTI DECK SHIPS[/h1][/b]
	
		The new hull editing framework allows you to extend the ship below and above the current decks.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/24ccc00e2baaf9cf348a050fb70b237f7f841922.png[/img]
		
	[b][h1]SUPPORT FOR VERY HIGH SHIP SPEEDS[/h1][/b]
	
		Complete redesign of the way ships transverse long distances, removed the legacy small scale mfm jump and replaced it with high speed pure newtonian physics baby!
		In this new setup ships have to accelerate half the way and decelerate the other half, boosters are toggled so you don't have to hold shift.
		Introducing the plasma mode for boosters, it needs the reactor to be functioning but it offers twice the acceleration power compared with pure fuel.
		Kinda nice to repair the ship while it's moving at 10km/s.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/3a7b894bce8c38731845ea3f3d3a4028576a86bc.png[/img]
		
	[b][h1]10 TIMES LARGER SECTORS[/h1][/b]
	
		Since the new accelerate/decelerate navigation method is way faster then the previous cap at 1km/s, sectors can afford to be way bigger.
		
	[b][h1]ROVER INVENTORY AND SUITDOCK[/h1][/b]
	
		No longer will you be limited on how much can you carry on planets in your inventory or by how long your suit o2 will last, the rover has you covered with the internal facilities that should cater to your needs like cargo hold, bunk, suit dock or toilet.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/9628e73049de026f3458ed68359037306b391975.gif[/img]
		
	[b][h1]NEW TRADING UI[/h1][/b]
	
		It's easier now to see what you can sell/buy and to trade in bulk with the new interaction panel.
		Also the loot tables for all traders have been tweaked.
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/dd35486a8ea5a1b126f297c3d4bc09d082399b2e.png[/img]
		
	[b][h1]NEW SOUNDTRACKS[/h1][/b]
	
		4 new soundtracks spread over 7 theme events.
		
	[b][h1]NEW CHALLENGE GAME MODE[/h1][/b]
	
		You are stuck on a abandoned wreckage filled with anti-personnel turrets, can you make your way to the closest station with only your trusted shotgun?
		
		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/08589fd38bfffdef7d0b3061e806edc0a05f93c8.png[/img]
		
	[b][h1]NEW RIROA9 SHIP[/h1][/b]
	
		New major version, new main ship. To keep inline with the update it is a multy-decker.
